name: [UPD3 💥]BRASS HELL BULLET INCREMENTAL
desc:
Welcome to BRASS HELL.

32+ Rounds. 16+ Weapons. Endless Orders.

Clock in at a remote ammunition factory buried in a blizzard. Manufacture rounds, pack crates, and earn your next upgrade. Unlock new ammunition, climb the leaderboards, and earn titles as you work your way through the factory. The orders never stop, and there’s more to this place than meets the eye.

⚙️ Manufacture 32+ different rounds through hands-on crafting
🔫 Discover 16+ weapons and the ammunition they use
📦 Fulfill shipments and upgrade your workshop
🏆 Compete on leaderboards and unlock tons of titles
🔓 Progress through new calibers and production equipment
👥 Share the factory with up to 4 players
📄 Discover hidden lore, scattered documents, and the secrets buried within the factory

Stay warm. Keep working.

🔧 Early release — new rounds, features, and updates on the way!

Credit: @wxyz1v (Thumbnail Artist)

llm.loop: manufacture ammunition by hand at machines -> pack crates and fulfill orders -> earn upgrades and new calibers -> uncover factory lore
llm.objectives: fulfil orders and unlock all rounds and weapons
